note: The bt-api API_VERSION range this bundle's guidance was written against. One number, not a matrix: bt-mcp refuses to serve unless bt-server reports the exact version it was built against, so whenever the endpoint answers at all, adapter and server agree. Widen `max` when a bump is verified not to change what the skills say; raise `min` when it does. 9->10 widened `max` (2026-08-05): the catalog reshape (#263) changed `GET /v1/catalog/{indicators,detectors}` breakingly, but no skill in this bundle references those routes, the DTO or its `category` field — checked, not assumed — so nothing this bundle SAYS is affected. 10->11 widened `max` (2026-08-05) on the same check, re-run rather than inherited: built-in detectors now report `type: "episodes"` where they reported `type: "detector"` on `GET /v1/catalog/detectors`, and grepping all five skills for `catalog/detectors`, `catalog/indicators`, `CatalogKindDto`, `CatalogOutputDto`, `episodes` and `detector` returned nothing at all — no skill names either route, the DTO, or any `ty` value, so no sentence in this bundle can go stale on the rename. 11->12 widened `max` (2026-08-09) on the same check, re-run a third time and widened to include `arity`: `GET /v1/catalog/{indicators,detectors}` now reports arity and outputs per version and filters on the union across versions (#390), and grepping all five skills for both route paths, all three catalog DTO names and the bare word `arity` returned nothing — no skill reads a catalog row at all, so nothing this bundle says depends on which version's shape a row summarizes. 12->13 widened `max` (2026-08-11): `CatalogKindDto` gained `params`, recovered from the engine's own chart factories (#511) — purely ADDITIVE, and the charting skill's new sentence about it is written to degrade ("if the row carries `params`"), so the bundle stays correct against a server at 12 that omits the field. `min` therefore stays where it is: nothing the bundle says becomes WRONG on an older server, it just has less to read.
